data.name: Outer Space Bar
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the Outer Space Bar! You are currently standing at the top of Earth’s most dangerous, highest, and... windiest vertical tunnel. Yes, in that shiny astronaut jumpsuit. Why are you here? That doesn’t matter. What matters is reaching the 'Bar' at the very edge of the sky.

One Button, Infinite Trials This is a hardcore vertical action game that tests your patience and timing. Using only the Space Bar, you must navigate the unstable currents of a vertical wind tunnel. Like a frantic 'Flappy' astronaut, time your presses to gain momentum and dodge narrow gaps and space debris flying from all directions.

An Astronaut’s Grueling Journey

  • The Merciless Vertical Tunnel: This tunnel is not your friend. Constantly changing currents and unpredictable obstacles will block your ascent.

  • Flappy-Style Extreme Timing: Perfect timing on the Space Bar is your only lifeline. A mere 0.1-second delay, and you’ll face the wrath of gravity (and the floor... the very deep floor).

  • Cosmic Difficulty: This game shows no mercy. It will suck in your sanity like a black hole.

Remember, the Outer Space Bar is no easy feat. But with every press of the Space Bar, you’ll experience the most exhilarating flight in the galaxy.

Now, hit the Space Bar and soar into the cosmos! (And please, try not to fall!)

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible GPU with 2 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
